title: Production Guardian — Health Scan API
description: Schemas for GET /api/healthscan/hosts and GET /api/healthscan/findings. Owner: Dev B. See healthscan-api.md.

host.description: Config item name exactly as it appears in IRIS. Join key for Finding.host.

type.description: Normalized host type. IRIS reports processes as 'actor'; we map actor -> process. Open string: render unknown values neutrally.

status.description: Host status as reported by IRIS. Enumerated for validation, but consumers must render unknown values neutrally rather than failing. Note there is no 'Warning'.

queued.description: Current queue depth. null means the depth is not measurable for this host — not that it is zero. Render as an em dash, never as 0. See Q13.

messagesPerSec.description: Throughput over the last sampling interval.

errored.description: Cumulative errored message count since production start. null means not measurable for this host — not zero errors. Render as an em dash, never as 0. See Q13.

avgProcessingTime.description: Seconds. Aggregated across message types, weighted by sample count.

avgQueueingTime.description: Seconds. Aggregated across message types, weighted by sample count.

lastActivity.description: ISO 8601 UTC. Derived as now minus IRIS elapsed-seconds, so accurate to roughly the poll interval.

id.description: Stable for the lifetime of the condition. Safe to key React lists on.

host.description: Always exactly equal to some Host.host value.

type.description: One of the eight finding types. Open string: unknown values must render with a neutral icon and humanized label.

severity.description: Unknown values must be treated as 'info'.

baselineValue.description: null while the rolling baseline is still warming up. Render as an em dash, never as 0 or NaN.

detectedAt.description: When the condition was first confirmed (after sustained breach), not when last seen.

HostsResponse.description: GET /api/healthscan/hosts. Empty array when no hosts, never 404.

FindingsResponse.description: GET /api/healthscan/findings. Empty array when no findings, never 404. Sorted detectedAt desc.
